name: Stackroom
summary: A ten-page stock and orders dashboard for a small product business, with a live rack map
about: A ten-page warehouse and order app for a small spice and snack brand in Karachi that sells online and to shops. Orders reserve stock, a pick-pack-ship board takes it out of the bins, and deliveries are checked in line by line before crates slide into their bins on the rack map. It also covers customers on credit, suppliers and reports.
how: Open a page from the sidebar; on a phone the menu button opens it.
Click a truck at the dock (or Check in on Receiving), count each line with the + and − buttons and mark damaged cases: differences are flagged before you book it in.
Booking in runs the put-away: crates slide into their bins and the bins glow on the rack map.
Save a new order to reserve stock, then drag it through To pick, Picking, Packed and Shipped (or use Move); packing takes units out of the bins.
Open a picking order for its pick list sorted by bin and tick each line before Mark packed unlocks.
On Warehouse, search for an item to flash its bins, filter low or empty bins, and click a bin to count it or move it.
Record payments from trade customers, switch Reports between 7D, 30D and 12M, and reset the demo from Settings.
